pages.text: Boats with green awnings floated all round the market. Each sold something different.
Mom sent Bung on an errand. Today, Bung wanted to manage well alone.
"Get green vegetables from the green-awning boat. The ducks—" Bung had already run off.
A green-awning boat stood over there. Bung held out a hand.
The woman gave Bung a bag. Bung hugged it and returned.
No green vegetables inside. Only red chilies!
Across the water stood another green-awning boat, selling green vegetables. Three ducks waddled beside it.
Mom took Bung's hand. "The green-awning boat, and...?"
Bung looked straight at Mom. "And?" "The one with the ducks."
Mom put green vegetables on the noodles. Bung's arms still smelled of the duck boat.
